# Security policy

Report J1 Code vulnerabilities through this repository's **Security ? Report a vulnerability** feature when private vulnerability reporting is enabled. Do not post credentials, pairing links, personal transcripts, or exploit details in public issues. If private reporting is unavailable, open an issue requesting a private reporting channel without disclosing the vulnerability.

J1 Code is independently maintained. Vulnerabilities in T3 Tools-operated infrastructure should be reported under the [upstream security policy](https://t3.codes/security-policy).
